title: ipfs mcp agent settings: read shape
description: Response body of GET on the settings route, and of a successful PUT (ADR-0009 sections 1, 5 and 7). The read never carries key material: a configured API key is reported only as api_key {set, source}. revision changes whenever any effective setting changes and is also exposed as the HTTP ETag response header; a write presents it as If-Match (a missing or stale value is refused with revision_conflict). The route is served only to an admin principal and answers 404 when no admin principal is configured or agent.settings.enabled is false; none of those states is this document.

backend.description: The effective agent-loop backend, resolved as flags > overlay > config (ADR-0009 section 7). null means no backend is configured; agent surfaces then answer backend_not_configured.

reason.description: Why the stored key was not applied to the new backend: the write changed the backend scheme, host or port and did not carry api_key (ADR-0012).

cleared.description: true when the key stored through this API was deleted by the move, so a move back needs the key re-entered. A key supplied by reference (environment variable or file) is never cleared and never produces this notice.

KeyNotCarried.description: Additive, optional, ADR-0012. Present only in the response to a successful PUT whose backend move withheld a key stored through this API; absent on GET and on every other write. After the move backend.api_key reports set false (there is no separate read-side field: clients learn the state from api_key.set). Absent is read as: nothing was withheld.

Revision.description: Opaque revision of the effective settings, exposed as the HTTP ETag. A write must present the current revision in If-Match; a stale one is refused with revision_conflict (412).

set.description: Whether a key is configured. Key material is never returned by any read.

source.description: Where the configured key comes from: settings_api (written through this API, stored as a 0600 file in the settings directory referenced as SecretRef{File}), environment (the variable named by llm.api_key), file (a SecretRef file, for example a Kubernetes Secret mount). Present exactly when set is true.

ApiKeyStatus.description: Key presence and provenance only. There is no field that can carry key material.

kind.description: openai: an operator-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (G10); kubo proxies the bounded agent loop to it. uar: kubo creates and proxies a Universal Agent Runtime agent (D14, ADR-0010).

base_url.description: Base URL of the backend endpoint. For openai this is the OpenAI-compatible base URL (llm.base_url); for uar the UAR instance URL.

safety_prefix.description: The fixed safety prefix the server always prepends to the system prompt (mcp-agent-hot-reload 1.4). It is set by the binary, is not writable through the API, and cannot be removed, emptied or overridden by custom. The effective system prompt is safety_prefix followed by custom.

custom.description: The operator-configured part of the system prompt. May be empty. It only ever extends safety_prefix, never replaces it.
